events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Does the medical director confirm the scope, team and calendar for the diagnostic?
agenda: Present the diagnostic scope, workstreams and deliverables
Align on the team and the roles of the three hospitals
Confirm the meeting calendar through week 6

events.label: Check-in: causes of waiting
events.decision: Do the causes of waiting stand as the basis for the cross-hospital comparison?
agenda: Present the waiting-time baseline and the patient journey maps
Review the causes of waiting by step and hospital
Confirm the causes that carry into the cross-hospital comparison

events.label: Final readout
events.decision: Does the medical director accept the waiting-time findings for all three hospitals?
agenda: Present the final readout of waiting-time findings
Review the cross-hospital comparison of waits and causes
Decide on acceptance of the findings for all three hospitals
